background: First Abu Dhabi Bank is the largest bank in the UAE, formed from the merger of National Bank of Abu Dhabi and First Gulf Bank, with the Abu Dhabi government and ruling family as its largest shareholders, with a large corporate, government and international franchise.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA- on average and all on a stable outlook, with no rating action in the last 90 days. CET1 is 13.7% and leverage 7.5%, with LCR at 140% and NSFR at 113%. Since 30 Jun 2025 leverage has risen 0.3 points and NSFR 7 points while LCR has fallen 12 points and CET1 has held steady (figures to 30 Jun 2026).
